sectionsUsed: Description of normalization: organizing data into related tables to eliminate redundancy and inconsistent dependency; redundant data must be changed in every location (o1, update anomaly)
Third normal form example: storing university data in Candidates means universities with no candidates cannot be listed (o1, insert problem)
First normal form: eliminate repeating groups, do not use multiple fields for similar data; second normal form: separate tables related with a foreign key (o1 multi-valued cells, o2 split)
5.5.4 Primary Keys and 5.5.5 Foreign Keys: the keys that link the split tables (o2)
3.3 Foreign Keys: referential integrity between related tables (o2)
